import Rhino,System,json,os
root='C:/Users/08432.SINOLTD/00.DEVE/31.AEC/RHINO_Deve/EnvironmentalSimulationHub'
path=os.path.join(root,'samples/quick_start/SolarPlate_4x4m.3dm')
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path),exist_ok=True)
doc=__rhino_doc__;before=len(list(doc.Objects))
model=Rhino.FileIO.File3dm();model.Settings.ModelUnitSystem=Rhino.UnitSystem.Meters
layer=Rhino.DocObjects.Layer();layer.Name='分析面_4x4m';layer.Color=System.Drawing.Color.Gray;model.Layers.Add(layer);index=0
brep=Rhino.Geometry.Brep.CreateFromCornerPoints(Rhino.Geometry.Point3d(0,0,0),Rhino.Geometry.Point3d(4,0,0),Rhino.Geometry.Point3d(4,4,0),Rhino.Geometry.Point3d(0,4,0),0.001)
attributes=Rhino.DocObjects.ObjectAttributes();attributes.Name='SolarPlate_4x4m';attributes.LayerIndex=index
model.Objects.AddBrep(brep,attributes)
assert model.Write(path,8)
copy=Rhino.FileIO.File3dm.Read(path)
assert copy.Settings.ModelUnitSystem==Rhino.UnitSystem.Meters and len(list(copy.Objects))==1
area=Rhino.Geometry.AreaMassProperties.Compute(list(copy.Objects)[0].Geometry).Area
assert abs(area-16)<1e-8 and before==len(list(doc.Objects))
report={'file':'samples/quick_start/SolarPlate_4x4m.3dm','unit':'Metres','objects':1,'area_m2':area,'source_document_unchanged':True,'scope':'RhinoCommon File3dm write/read and geometry checks only; colleague machine/native first-use trial pending.'}
json.dump(report,open(os.path.join(root,'docs/evidence/quick_start_model_087.json'),'w',encoding='utf-8'),indent=2)
print(json.dumps(report))
